title: What to expect from Permanent Deletion

question.author: member_158
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for permanent deletion?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Recycle Bin and Deletion documentation says: Emptying the recycle bin, or deleting an item from inside the bin, is irreversible. There is no recovery path for permanently deleted files, including through support. Organization administrators can disable the "Empty recycle bin" button for members via the admin console if accidental mass deletions are a concern. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
